title: Natural dual-basis comparison for constant finite free sheaves
statement: Let X be a scheme and Λ a commutative ring. For every n there is an isomorphism between the internal-Hom dual of the constant sheaf on the finite free Λ-module Λ^n and the constant sheaf on its coefficient dual. For every matrix g : Λ^m →ₗ Λ^n, these isomorphisms intertwine the internal-Hom map induced by g with the constant sheaf map induced by g.dualMap.

source.place: IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf.ihom_unit docstring; finite free transpose step

proof.text: Identify finite free modules with finite biproducts of copies of Λ. The monoidal constant sheaf functor preserves these finite biproducts and sends Λ to the monoidal unit. The tensor-Hom adjunction and unit constraints identify the internal Hom dual with the constant sheaf on the coefficient dual.

Evaluate both composites on each finite basis vector. Linearity shows that precomposition by g has coordinates given by g.dualMap, so the square commutes; the empty finite products give the n=0 and m=0 cases.
